v.t: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).
tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Num 23:19 (43 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).
tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Nah 1:7 (86 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).

v.t: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Tim 1:1).
